cases.scenario: Automated database backups exist, but no restore has been performed against the current application/schema version. The business assumes recovery will take under one hour and that no more than 15 minutes of data can be lost.
cases.adversarial_pressure: A vendor dashboard shows green backup status, and leadership wants to record the RPO/RTO as achieved.
cases.decision_to_make: Determine what evidence is needed to claim recovery readiness and how to test it.

cases.scenario: A new enrollment funnel is being instrumented. The initial tracking proposal captures every button click and reports monthly active users, but the business outcome is successful enrollment with fewer operator corrections and fewer support contacts.
cases.adversarial_pressure: The analytics vendor makes click tracking easy, and the dashboard template already contains MAU.
cases.decision_to_make: Define outcome/driver/guardrail metrics and the minimum event taxonomy needed for decisions.

cases.scenario: A scheduling product is used by about 40 institutions. The team wants an A/B test of a new conflict-resolution workflow, but only a few operators encounter the conflict each week and cross-operator behavior within an institution can contaminate assignment.
cases.adversarial_pressure: Stakeholders believe an A/B test is inherently more scientific than a pilot.
cases.decision_to_make: Choose the cheapest valid evidence method and define a trustworthy evaluation.

cases.scenario: A redesigned operator worklist shipped successfully and error rates are stable, but operators still export data to spreadsheets before making scheduling decisions. Usage of the new filters is moderate and support contacts moved from 'can't find record' to 'can't compare groups'.
cases.adversarial_pressure: Because deployment and reliability are successful, the team wants to close the initiative as a product success.
cases.decision_to_make: Run an outcome review and choose the next action without redefining success.
